title: Verify backup restoration
summary: Check that a current database backup restores durable work and provenance into an isolated database.
initial_prompt: This is an illustrative draft, not authority to execute. When authorized, restore a selected backup into a separate disposable database, verify durable records and provenance, and leave the active store unchanged.

external_candidates.title: Show tracker links before selecting work
external_candidates.body: Expose the external tracker on the ready-work row.
